description: This file acts as the server entry point for a Remix framework application, handling HTTP requests and rendering responses. It manages both bot and browser requests, enabling server-side streaming of the app, and sets CORS headers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main entry function to handle incoming HTTP requests and route to bot or browser-specific rendering.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side stream rendering when requests originate from bots based on user-agent detection.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side stream rendering for browser clients.
